mapper.select: SELECT crFile.CN_SERIAL, crFile.CR_NO, crFile.FILE_NO, crFile.DOCS_FILE_PATH_NM, crFile.ORG_FILE_NM, request.REQUEST_NO, 'DRAWING' AS aclObjectType, drawing.OBJECT_ID AS aclObjectId, CAST(crFile.FILE_NO AS TEXT) AS aclFileNo FROM ITN_CR_FILE crFile JOIN ITN_CR cr ON cr.CR_NO = crFile.CR_NO JOIN DOCS_REQUEST_MAPPING requestMapping ON requestMapping.OBJECT_ID = cr.CR_NO JOIN DOCS_REQUEST request ON request.REQUEST_NO = requestMapping.REQUEST_NO JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT docsDrawing.OBJECT_ID FROM DOCS_DRAWING docsDrawing WHERE docsDrawing.DRAWING_NO = cr.DRAWING_NO AND (NULLIF(cr.REV_NO, '') IS NULL OR docsDrawing.DRAWING_REV = cr.REV_NO) ORDER BY docsDrawing.INTERFACE_DT DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 1 ) drawing ON TRUE WHERE crFile.CR_NO = #{crNo} AND crFile.FILE_NO = #{fileNo} AND ( request.INSERT_USER_CD = #{sessionUser.userCd} OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM DOCS_REQUEST_DETAIL accessDetail WHERE accessDetail.REQUEST_NO = request.REQUEST_NO AND (accessDetail.ORIGINAL_USER_CD = #{sessionUser.userCd} OR accessDetail.ACTUAL_USER_CD = #{sessionUser.userCd}) ) ) ORDER BY request.REQUEST_NO LIMIT 1

SELECT requestFile.OBJECT_ID AS crNo, requestFile.FILE_NO, requestFile.FILE_PATH_NM AS docsFilePathNm, requestFile.ORG_FILE_NM AS orgFileNm, request.REQUEST_NO, 'DRAWING' AS aclObjectType, drawing.OBJECT_ID AS aclObjectId, CAST(requestFile.FILE_NO AS TEXT) AS aclFileNo FROM DOCS_REQUEST_FILE requestFile JOIN DOCS_REQUEST_MAPPING requestMapping ON requestMapping.REQUEST_NO = requestFile.REQUEST_NO AND requestMapping.OBJECT_ID = requestFile.OBJECT_ID JOIN DOCS_REQUEST request ON request.REQUEST_NO = requestFile.REQUEST_NO JOIN DOCS_USER actor ON actor.USER_CD = #{sessionUser.userCd} JOIN DOCS_USER ownerUser ON ownerUser.USER_CD = request.INSERT_USER_CD JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT docsDrawing.OBJECT_ID FROM DOCS_DRAWING docsDrawing WHERE docsDrawing.DRAWING_NO = requestMapping.OBJECT_NO AND (NULLIF(requestMapping.REV_NO, '') IS NULL OR docsDrawing.DRAWING_REV = requestMapping.REV_NO) ORDER BY docsDrawing.INTERFACE_DT DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 1 ) drawing ON TRUE WHERE requestFile.OBJECT_ID = #{crNo} AND requestFile.FILE_NO = CAST(#{fileNo} AS TEXT) AND ( ownerUser.COMPANY_CD = actor.COMPANY_CD OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM DOCS_REQUEST_DETAIL accessDetail WHERE accessDetail.REQUEST_NO = request.REQUEST_NO AND (accessDetail.ORIGINAL_USER_CD = actor.USER_CD OR accessDetail.ACTUAL_USER_CD = actor.USER_CD) ) ) ORDER BY request.REQUEST_NO LIMIT 1

SELECT crFile.CN_SERIAL, crFile.CR_NO, crFile.FILE_NM, crFile.FILE_SIZE, crFile.FILE_NO, crFile.ORG_FILE_NM FROM ITN_CR_FILE crFile JOIN DOCS_REQUEST_MAPPING requestMapping ON requestMapping.OBJECT_ID = crFile.CR_NO JOIN DOCS_REQUEST request ON request.REQUEST_NO = requestMapping.REQUEST_NO WHERE crFile.CR_NO = #{crNo} AND ( request.INSERT_USER_CD = #{sessionUser.userCd} OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM DOCS_REQUEST_DETAIL accessDetail WHERE accessDetail.REQUEST_NO = request.REQUEST_NO AND (accessDetail.ORIGINAL_USER_CD = #{sessionUser.userCd} OR accessDetail.ACTUAL_USER_CD = #{sessionUser.userCd}) ) ) ORDER BY crFile.FILE_NO

SELECT requestFile.OBJECT_ID AS crNo, requestFile.FILE_NO AS fileNo, requestFile.ORG_FILE_NM AS orgFileNm FROM DOCS_REQUEST_FILE requestFile JOIN DOCS_REQUEST request ON request.REQUEST_NO = requestFile.REQUEST_NO JOIN DOCS_USER actor ON actor.USER_CD = #{sessionUser.userCd} JOIN DOCS_USER ownerUser ON ownerUser.USER_CD = request.INSERT_USER_CD WHERE requestFile.OBJECT_ID = #{crNo} AND ( ownerUser.COMPANY_CD = actor.COMPANY_CD OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM DOCS_REQUEST_DETAIL accessDetail WHERE accessDetail.REQUEST_NO = request.REQUEST_NO AND (accessDetail.ORIGINAL_USER_CD = actor.USER_CD OR accessDetail.ACTUAL_USER_CD = actor.USER_CD) ) ) ORDER BY requestFile.FILE_NO
